# Santorini Travel Envelope

> An interactive digital paper artifact about place, postage, and anticipation.

## Canonical URL

https://envelope.sanskarshukla.com/

## Description

Santorini Travel Envelope is a tactile web experience showing an aged cream envelope addressed to Santorini, Greece. Visitors press an oxblood wax seal to begin the opening gesture: the seal compresses, fractures, sheds a small wax chip, and releases the twine.

## Interaction

The primary interaction is the labeled wax-seal button. It supports pointer input and keyboard activation with Enter or Space. Decorative artwork is rendered with inline SVG and layered CSS materials.

## Technology

React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS, inline SVG, WebP textures, Fontsource fonts, and a dependency-free requestAnimationFrame timeline.

## Topics

interactive envelope, Santorini, digital paper artifact, tactile web design, SVG illustration, wax seal interaction, creative frontend portfolio
